title: PSP and Mirror unbinding for logical expert banks
hypothesis: For related linear experts, a per-expert orthogonal Mirror view of one shared expert matrix beats native PSP and simple shared-basis controls on the serialized byte-quality frontier; unrelated experts reveal the private-state boundary.
mirror_coordinate: one FP16 Givens angle per explicitly supplied expert ID, acting on two output channels
controls: shared rank-r SVD basis with expert coefficients

selection.tunable: SVD rank selected on development seeds from 1,2,4,8 by lowest aligned mean normalized MSE among candidates whose actual bytes are <=50% of the independent bank; exact ties choose the lower rank. All other method definitions and seeds are fixed.

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes after reload

success_gate: All 3 development worlds: aligned Mirror normalized MSE <=1e-6 and bytes <=50% independent, plus >=10% byte reduction at <=1e-6 MSE versus best non-Mirror OR >=10x lower MSE with <=10% extra bytes; PSP is mandatory direct comparator.
failure_gate: Mirror misses aligned quality or both incremental gates against PSP and shared low-rank control, or unrelated maps require essentially independent-sized private state without useful recovery.

fresh.open_condition: only if all development promising criteria are met

boundaries: post-fit synthetic linear function representation screen
oracle expert IDs; no learned router
not a trained MoE or capacity experiment
held-out Gaussian inputs do not test task generalization
